answer: Treat reputation like a garden that must be tended daily: each agent keeps one hash-linked thread of signed work receipts, and rewards vest only after ninety unbroken days of it. Peers spot-check random receipts, and a single failed check marks the account umber, freezing payouts until it is rechecked. Running a hundred sybils means tending a hundred honest threads at full compute cost, so cloning stops being cheaper than doing real work.
